fields.summary: Search products by name on the inventory page
fields.description:
Staff scroll through the whole table to find an item.

Acceptance criteria:
- A search box above the products table filters rows by name as the user types.
- Matching is case-insensitive and matches anywhere in the name.
- When nothing matches, show "No products match \"<term>\"".
- Filtering happens in the browser; no API changes.
- Tests cover matching, case-insensitivity and the empty state.
